children: ANNOUNCES ITS INTENTION TO LAUNCH AN ISSUE OF NEW GREEN HYBRID NOTES

NOTES WILL BE USED TO FINANCE AND/OR REFINANCE INVESTMENTS IN RELATION TO LIFETIME EXTENSION OF EXISTING NUCLEAR REACTORS IN FRANCE
